title: To-Do List
description: A responsive task management application with Dark/Light mode, multilingual support, LocalStorage, filtering, and progress tracking.
overview: This project was created to help users organize and manage their daily tasks through a simple, responsive, and user-friendly interface.
features: Arabic, English and Turkish language support

title: Portfolio
description: A showcase of projects I have designed and developed, from responsive websites to user interface designs.
overview: This personal portfolio presents my skills, experience, and software projects through a modern and responsive interface.

title: LogisticsNotes.API
description: A backend API developed with ASP.NET Core and C# to manage logistics records. The project includes RESTful endpoints, database integration, and CRUD operations.
overview: This API manages logistics notes and records using a structured backend architecture and RESTful services.

title: 16-Bit Processor Design and Sequencing Algorithm
description: A 16-bit processor designed using Logisim to demonstrate the fundamentals of computer architecture, instruction execution, and digital logic design.
overview: This project focuses on designing and simulating a 16-bit processor in Logisim. It includes the implementation of core processor components, instruction execution, and sequencing logic to demonstrate how a CPU operates at the hardware level.
features: Tested digital circuits and instruction flow

title: Library Management System
description: A Library Management System developed using Java Swing and MySQL to manage books, members, and borrowing operations through a simple desktop interface.
overview: This project was built with Java Swing for the graphical user interface and MySQL as the database. It allows users to add, update, delete, and search for books while efficiently managing library records.
features: Connect to MySQL database using JDBC
